dataset_metadata.disclaimer: New AI-generated English drafts of the recorded Classical Chinese; not scholarly reviewed. Original source interpretations are not verified geometry or modern etymology.

shuowen:8101.text: A title for an old woman. Formed from 女, with 𥁕 indicating the sound. Read like 奥.

shuowen:8102.text: A mother or old woman. Formed from 女, with 句 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8103.text: In Shu, a mother is called 姐; in Huainan, 社. Formed from 女, with 且 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8104.text: A husband's mother. Formed from 女, with 古 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8105.text: A mother-in-law. Formed from 女 and 戌. The Han Statutes says: 'A wife accusing her 威姑, her mother-in-law.'

shuowen:8106.text: A deceased mother. Formed from 女, with 比 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8107.text: An elder sister. Formed from 女, with 𠂔 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8108.text: A younger sister. Formed from 女, with 未 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8109.text: A younger sister. Formed from 女 and 弟; 弟 also indicates the sound.

shuowen:8110.text: People of Chu call a younger sister 媦. Formed from 女, with 胃 indicating the sound. The Gongyang Commentary says: 'The king of Chu's 妻媦,' apparently his wife and younger sister.

shuowen:8111.text: An elder brother's wife. Formed from 女, with 叜 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8112.text: An elder brother's daughter. Formed from 女, with 至 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8113.text: A wife's younger sister, born of the same parents, is called 姨. Formed from 女, with 夷 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8114.text: A female teacher. Formed from 女, with 加 indicating the sound. Du Lin says it means giving instruction to women. Read like 阿.

shuowen:8115.text: A female teacher. Formed from 女, with 𣫭 indicating the sound. Read like 母.

shuowen:8116.text: A repeated marriage alliance. Formed from 女, with 冓 indicating the sound. The Changes says: 'Not robbers, but marriage allies.'

shuowen:8117.text: A beautiful woman. Formed from 女, with 多 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8118.text: A woman's beauty. Formed from 女, with 犮 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8119.text: A female bondservant. Formed from 女, with 奚 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8120.text: A woman of low status. Formed from 女 and 卑; 卑 also indicates the sound.

shuowen:8121.text: Male and female slaves were all offenders in antiquity. The Rites of Zhou says: 'Of their slaves, men enter the penal bondservants; women enter the grain-pounding and straw-processing service.' Formed from 女 and 又.

shuowen:8122.text: A female official. Formed from 女, with 弋 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8123.text: Master Gan's Classic of the Stars says: 'Taibai is the high duke; his wife is called 女媊. 女媊 resides at the Southern Dipper, feeds on harmful spirits, and is sacrificed to throughout the world. She is called the Bright Star.' Formed from 女, with 前 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8124.text: An ancient divine and sage woman who transformed and created all things. Formed from 女, with 咼 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8125.text: The designation of Emperor Gaoxin's consort, mother of Xie. Formed from 女, with 戎 indicating the sound. The Odes says: 'The You-Song clan was flourishing.'

shuowen:8126.text: The name of Ehuang, Emperor Yao's daughter and Shun's wife. In Qin and Jin, beauty is called 娙娥. Formed from 女, with 我 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8127.text: The name of the woman of Tai state who was mother of Qi of Zhou. Formed from 女, with 原 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8128.text: A woman's name. Formed from 女, with 燕 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8129.text: A woman's name. Formed from 女, with 可 indicating the sound. Read like 阿.

shuowen:8130.text: A woman's name. The Songs of Chu says: 'Nü Xu clung to me in concern.' Attendant Jia explains: people of Chu call an elder sister 𡡓. Formed from 女, with 須 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8131.text: A woman's name. Formed from 女, with 疌 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8132.text: A woman's name. Formed from 女, with 與 indicating the sound. Read like 余.

shuowen:8133.text: A woman's name. Formed from 女, with 霝 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8134.text: A woman's name. Formed from 女, with 尞 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8135.text: A woman's name. Formed from 女, with 衣 indicating the sound. Read like 衣.

shuowen:8136.text: A woman's name. Formed from 女, with 周 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8137.text: A woman's name. Formed from 女, with 合 indicating the sound. The Spring and Autumn Commentary says: 'The favored woman Chou'e.' Alternatively, soundless.

shuowen:8138.text: A woman's name. Formed from 女, with 己 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8139.text: A woman's name. Formed from 女, with 主 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8140.text: A woman's name. Formed from 女, with 久 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8141.text: A woman's appellation. Formed from 女, with 耳 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8142.text: A woman's beginning. Formed from 女, with 台 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8143.text: Pleasing. Formed from 女, with 眉 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8144.text: Graceful, as in 𡡾. Formed from 女, with 無 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8145.text: Beautiful in complexion. Formed from 女 and 美; 美 also indicates the sound.

shuowen:8146.text: Graceful, as in 𡡾. Formed from 女, with 畜 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8147.text: Beyond southern Chu, beauty is called 嫷. Formed from 女, with 隋 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8148.text: Beautiful. Formed from 女, with 朱 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8149.text: Beautiful. Formed from 女 and 子.

shuowen:8150.text: Pleased. Formed from 女, with 興 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8151.text: Beautiful. Formed from 女, with 厭 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8152.text: Beautiful. Formed from 女, with 殳 indicating the sound. The Odes says: 'The quiet maiden is beautiful.'

shuowen:8153.text: Beautiful. Formed from 女, with 交 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8154.text: Beautiful. Formed from 女, with 𡚇 indicating the sound. Read like the name of a cloth from Shu commandery.

shuowen:8155.text: Beautiful. Formed from 女, with 兌 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8156.text: Beautiful within the eyes, apparently. Formed from 女, with 苗 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8157.text: Quietly beautiful. Formed from 女, with 畫 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8158.text: Beautiful in body and virtue. Formed from 女, with 官 indicating the sound. Read like 宛 in the name of Chu's Xi Wan.

shuowen:8159.text: Tall and beautiful. Formed from 女, with 坙 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8160.text: Fair and beautiful. Formed from 女, with 贊 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8161.text: Compliant. Formed from 女, with 𤔔 indicating the sound. The Odes says: 'Gentle and compliant.'

shuowen:8162.text: Gentle and compliant. Formed from 女, with 夗 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8163.text: Compliant. Formed from 女, with 宛 indicating the sound. The Spring and Autumn Commentary says: 'Crown Prince Cuo was gentle.'

shuowen:8164.text: An upright-necked appearance. Formed from 女, with 同 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8165.text: A tall appearance. Formed from 女, with 焉 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8166.text: A delicate, elongated appearance. Formed from 女, with 冄 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8167.text: Delicate and elongated, as in 㚩. Formed from 女 and 弱.

shuowen:8168.text: Pointed and fine. Formed from 女, with 韱 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8169.text: The condition expressed by 嬰嫇, apparently childlike. Formed from 女, with 冥 indicating the sound. Alternatively, 嫇嫇 is the appearance of a small person.

shuowen:8170.text: The appearance of walking with bent shoulders. Formed from 女, with 䍃 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8171.text: Quick and able. Formed from 女, with 瞏 indicating the sound. The Spring and Autumn Commentary says: 'All alone in sorrow.'

shuowen:8172.text: With a composed body, walking gracefully. Formed from 女, with 危 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8173.text: To bend and follow. Formed from 女 and 禾.

shuowen:8174.text: The condition expressed by 㛂, apparently pliant. Alternatively, a female attendant is called 婐. Read like 騧, or like 委. Formed from 女, with 果 indicating the sound. Meng Ke says: 'Shun was Son of Heaven, and the two women attended him.'

shuowen:8175.text: The condition expressed by 婐㛂, apparently pliant. Alternatively, weak. Formed from 女, with 𠂬 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8176.text: Small and weak. Alternatively, a woman frivolous and good at running; alternatively, skilled in many arts. Formed from 女, with 占 indicating the sound. Also read like 占.

shuowen:8177.text: The condition expressed by 妗, perhaps smiling. Formed from 女, with 沾 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8178.text: The condition expressed by 𡝫妗, perhaps smiling. Alternatively, an appearance of smiling readily. Formed from 女, with 今 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8179.text: To hold the body erect. Formed from 女, with 簋 indicating the sound. Read like 糾 in the Odes' 'Twisted hemp sandals.'

shuowen:8180.text: To stand erect. Formed from 女, with 青 indicating the sound. Alternatively, talented. Read like 菁 in 韭菁.

shuowen:8181.text: Quiet. Formed from 女, with 井 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8182.text: A woman's appearance. Formed from 女, with 乏 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8183.text: Beautiful. Formed from 女, with 旋 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8184.text: Talented. Formed from 女, with 齊 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8185.text: Ugly in the face. Formed from 女, with 𠯑 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8186.text: An upright, beautiful appearance. Alternatively, enchanting. Formed from 女, with 翟 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8187.text: The quality expressed by 媞, apparently fine or delicate. Formed from 女, with 規 indicating the sound. Read like 癸. In Qin and Jin, fineness is called 嫢.

shuowen:8188.text: Careful or discerning. Alternatively, beautiful and clever; alternatively, between the 江 and 淮 a mother is called 媞. Formed from 女, with 是 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8189.text: Not following. Formed from 女, with 敄 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8190.text: Refined. Formed from 女, with 閒 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8191.text: Pleased and joyful. Formed from 女, with 巸 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8192.text: Beautiful. Formed from 女, with 臤 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8193.text: Joyful. Formed from 女, with 吳 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8194.text: To play. Formed from 女, with 矣 indicating the sound. Alternatively, a designation for someone of low status.

shuowen:8195.text: Joyful. Formed from 女, with 甚 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8196.text: Compliant. Formed from 女, with 尾 indicating the sound. Read like 𡡾.

shuowen:8197.text: Careful, as in 孎. Formed from 女, with 啻 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8198.text: Careful. Formed from 女, with 屬 indicating the sound. Read like 孎, the term for a person being disrespectful.

shuowen:8199.text: The condition expressed by 宴𡟰, apparently composed and gentle. Formed from 女, with 冤 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8200.text: A woman harboring thoughts in an uncertain or hesitant manner. Formed from 女, with 弇 indicating the sound.
